newsitem.title: USA: Performance Food sees 1997 sales, net up.
newsitem.headline: Performance Food sees 1997 sales, net up.

text.p: Performance Food Group Co said Tuesday it expects to report higher net sales and earnings for 1997.

In 1996, the company posted net income of $11 million, or $0.94 per share, on net sales of $784.2 million. The company said its chairman and chief executive, Robert Sledd, offered the projection at its annual shareholders' meeting today.
The projection also came a week after the Performance Food released its first quarter results, showing net income of $2.3 million, or $0.19 per share, on sales of $268.5 million.
"We expect to maintain this positive momentum and are confident about achieving higher sales and earnings for 1997 as a whole," Sledd said in a statement.

In the prior year's first quarter, Performance Food posted net income of $1.7 million, or $0.16 per share. Its sales for this year's first quarter were up 55 percent over the same period in the prior year.
